description: Weekly dependency updates. The commit type decides the release (docs/releasing.md): what ships in the images, the chart or the UI is fix(deps), a patch release; CI-only updates are ci(deps), and the dev compose file chore(deps), which release nothing.

customManagers.description: semantic-release and its plugins, pinned in the release workflow

packageRules.description: Updates ship in the images, the chart or the UI: fix(deps), a patch release.
Actions and release tooling only affect CI: ci(deps), no release.
The local docker compose stack isn't shipped: chore(deps), no release.
Minor and patch updates come as one PR per area each week; majors get their own PRs.
The go directive and the golang build image move together, or the image build breaks.
